scripts.postinstall: python -m pip install -r backend/requirements.txt || echo "Backend dependency install skipped"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c green,blue "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && alembic upgrade head && uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c green,blue "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
scripts.start:backend: cd backend && alembic upgrade head && uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
